prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI sprite atlas for an original SOVEREIGN legendary leaderboard frame. Create ONE polished 1536 by 1024 landscape PNG with genuine transparent alpha outside the artwork. Strict three-cell atlas layout, no text, no labels, no grid: TOP HALF (x0..1536,y0..512): one broad royal gold crown crest, centered at (768,256), decorative silhouette about 1300x340, mirrored sweeping gold wings, laurel carvings, a regal central faceted amber jewel and three crown points. Leave 50px transparent margins inside this top cell; nothing from another cell enters it. BOTTOM LEFT cell (x0..512,y512..1024): a single L-shaped ornate upper-left corner armor, about 380x380, centered in cell, with sharp gilded wing tips protruding outward and a right-angle dark bronze rail that runs right and down. Open interior toward bottom-right, no rectangular backing. BOTTOM RIGHT cell (x512..1536,y512..1024): fill this entire 1024x512 rectangular tile with very dark warm bronze and black-gold engraved metal material, subtle elegant low-contrast grain and dark amber edge illumination, mostly smooth dark center to keep white UI text readable. All three parts share the same material. Style: high-end hand-painted 3D fantasy MOBA ranked-reward art, sculpted solid metal with bevels, intricately engraved relief, rich shaded recesses, luminous rim highlights, believable metallic reflections and gemstone depth. Rendered game production asset, not flat vector, not CSS-looking line art. No letters, names, ranks, characters, faces, interface mockup, watermark or existing game logos. Front orthographic view; clean accurate silhouette. Outer empty areas and the open corner are truly transparent, never checkerboard pixels. The bottom-right material tile is deliberately opaque. Make the royal ornament dramatic and premium but keep individual small details visually coherent at thumbnail size.
